auditKind: Evidence index for real followup runtime tests, preserved failures, corrections, and explicitly unverified paths
coveragePercentageReason: The 26 known inventory rows group features and candidates. They do not enumerate all conditional, remote, plugin, or server-side model calls. Counts below are row classifications, not coverage or confidence percentages.

authentication.mode: isolated explicit BYOK through unmodified official Claude Code SDK/CLI

statusDefinitions.verified_scoped: A real runtime path has passing scoped acceptance evidence listed in this row. This does not imply every variant in the broad feature name is verified.
statusDefinitions.historical_only: Earlier scoped runtime evidence is retained; this followup did not rerun that distinct path.
statusDefinitions.pending: Fresh acceptance is not final in this snapshot. Earlier failures/interruption are retained and must not be promoted to PASS.
statusDefinitions.blocked_current_configuration: The real public entrypoint/catalog is unavailable or rejects under the authorized isolated configuration. A different explicitly named alternative, if verified, is not the original service.
statusDefinitions.not_verified: Static candidate or specialized service has no matching real semantic acceptance. Adjacent native behavior and synthetic guards do not count as that path.
statusDefinitions.unknown_not_enumerable: A distinct path is unestablished or the remaining surface cannot be exhaustively enumerated.

evidenceRules: Preserved failed and interrupted runs are evidence of regressions or incomplete tests; later passes do not rewrite their status.
Official Factory runtime tests, native SDK tests with synthetic hosts, and direct synthetic guard probes are explicitly distinguished.
Factory Summarizer, native Claude compaction, and the unestablished Task-summary helper are distinct rows.
Missing cache creation fields remain unknown; cache-read observations cannot establish exact hit ratio, subscription consumption, or billing safety.
Configured API sink observations do not establish complete egress interception or absence of internal services.
No production subscription account, binary patch, hosted authentication bypass, or fabricated classifier/image output was used.

entries.name: Normal Droid session continuation with native SDK checkpoint

entries.name: Claude Code provider-side prompt-cache reuse
verifiedOrObserved: The real resumed native turn reported 23040 cache-read tokens; post-Factory-manual-compaction continuation reported 23872 cache-read tokens while preserving native identity.
remainingLimitations: Provider cache-creation fields are absent from knownFields; any normalized zero is unknown, not zero cost.
These are scoped cache-reuse observations, not a controlled cost benchmark, exact cache-hit ratio, Anthropic subscription measurement, or guarantee for arbitrarily changed prompts/tools.

entries.name: Factory Task child sessions and built-in subagent roles
verifiedOrObserved: Actual Factory Task awaited a successful child result; child prompt matched delegation, native child was distinct, real child Read obtained a nonce absent from its prompt, and child/parent result JSON was correct.
Explicit custom Droid execution preserved a body-only marker and selected its configured Bridge model alias.
remainingLimitations: The interactive parent had no native file access during the delegation turn; an earlier generation-command turn had read the fixture, so this is not a whole-session nonaccess assertion.

Original observations and raw request evidence are preserved; this row is not marked verified.

entries.name: Dynamic Factory tool discovery and MCP host callback

entries.name: Native tool permission, denial, cancellation and stale-result rejection
verifiedOrObserved: Real Factory only-tools policy denied native Bash in Read-only turns, allowed it when Execute was granted, and denied it after revocation.
Authenticated Factory spec mode mechanically denied native Write before the real ExitSpecMode approval and then permitted implementation.
After an independently observed shell-start marker, interactive Escape stopped native turns in 3756 ms; the delayed output remained absent after a 47000 ms observation exceeding the shell delay.
remainingLimitations: These are native authority and cancellation paths, not Factory command-risk or Droid Shield classifier execution.
Historical stale-result and approval-controller tests remain separate; not every UI/controller variant was rerun.

entries.name: Factory lifecycle hooks, once-only ownership and session generation
verifiedOrObserved: Real UserPromptSubmit refreshed authenticated binding after automatic Factory compaction; separate post-boundary turn retained the original native session.
Real SessionStart(source=compact, previous_session_id) safely transitioned same-worker handoff to a distinct native session.
Official process resume remained resumable, and actual TTY Escape stopped the owned native work with normal process exit and complete cleanup.
remainingLimitations: Hooks bind the exercised host sessions; they do not prove every internal or remote Factory model request uses Bridge.
Arbitrary concurrent desktop/daemon/remote-worker lifecycles remain outside these probes.

entries.name: Factory session-title generation helpers
verifiedOrObserved: The real JSON-RPC session emitted a nonempty session_title_updated notification with updateType=llm_generated; real TTY sessions also persisted generated titles.
remainingLimitations: First-file-edit title stages, model-fallback branches, and every title helper variant remain unverified.

entries.name: Factory own conversation Summarizer / compaction / handoff
verifiedOrObserved: Actual automatic Factory compaction removed one initial context message at a public lowered 12000-token threshold; a separate subsequent user turn recalled the facts in the same native session.
Actual manual current-session compaction removed 14 messages, retained tested values in the summary, and continued the same native session.
Actual same-worker handoff removed 19 messages, retained the facts, and loaded the new Factory session into a distinct native session.
The manual continuity, automatic binding-loss, and same-worker handoff regressions have preserved failures and passing real reruns.
remainingLimitations: The automatic fixture removed an initial hook/context message; it does not establish default-threshold or large semantic-history automatic summarization fidelity.
Summary fallback models/reasoning modes, arbitrary histories with pending tool callbacks, and all long Missions are not covered.
Factory Summarizer is distinct from native Claude compaction and from any unestablished Task-result summary helper.

entries.name: Factory spec planning model and ExitSpecMode transition
verifiedOrObserved: Official --use-spec workflow advertised and executed the real Factory ExitSpecMode tool, observed approval, then completed an independently verified native file result.
A live attempted native Write before approval was denied and its output file remained absent; approved implementation then succeeded.
remainingLimitations: New-session spec mode and auto-high approval were exercised. All interactive approval variants and heterogeneous upstream models remain unverified.
The first reproduced missing ExitSpecMode tool attempt remains in the aggregate; successful reruns use the corrected official tool list.

entries.name: Interactive /review flow and review Skill
verifiedOrObserved: The actual /review slash-menu invoked the built-in review Skill on a known diff, reported the multiplication/division regression, and left the fixture unchanged; PTY and driver exited successfully.
remainingLimitations: This validates a local known diff; remote PR ingestion, every review target selection, and other models are outside the run.

entries.name: AI-generated custom Droid configuration from /droids
verifiedOrObserved: Actual /droids hosted generation returned Factory-auth 401 and added zero Bridge model requests.

The separate /relay-droid project-command alternative generated a usable project Droid through configured BYOK; real Factory Task execution of that child passed strict prompt, native Read, nonce, result, and session checks.
remainingLimitations: The original Factory hosted GenerateDroid model route is not verified or made BYOK by this alternative.
The replacement is an explicit user-invoked project command; it does not impersonate the hosted service or bypass Factory authentication.

remainingLimitations: No Auto classifier, routing decision, deterministic single-candidate skip, or fallback model path was executed.
Requires an officially supported authorized Auto configuration to verify this distinct service; fixed custom-model success does not substitute for it.

verifiedOrObserved: A direct synthetic Bridge probe requiring logprobs/top_logprobs/response_format was rejected with 422 unsupported_output_contract before native execution.

The current native-agent output route cannot honor the specialized token-probability/constrained-response contract; a separately authorized compatible model route would be needed.
Availability under official consent/account/feature configuration remains unverified; feature flags and authentication were not patched.

entries.name: GenerateImage model tool and image-edit model requests
verifiedOrObserved: The real isolated Factory tool catalog did not advertise GenerateImage; the configured native route has no verified generated-image/audio output contract.

Text-model success and synthetic specialized-output rejection cannot be counted as image-model execution. An authorized compatible image backend is needed.

entries.name: Other frontends, remote services, plugins and future/conditional model surfaces
verifiedOrObserved: Fresh real public transport coverage includes production exec/--session-id, stream-jsonrpc Factory compaction/handoff, and TTY /review, /droids rejection, /relay-droid alternative, and Escape cancellation.
remainingLimitations: ACP, all fork variants, desktop/daemon/remote worker frontends, arbitrary MCP/plugins, and remotely configured/server-side model calls are not exhaustively verified.
The 26 inventory rows are candidate feature groupings, not the complete number of Factory internal model callsites; no coverage percentage can be computed.
